Clinical: ACC.org summary of the 2018 ACC/AHA cholesterol guideline (CAC may be considered in adults 40-75 at intermediate 10-year risk when the statin decision is uncertain; CAC 0 may withhold or delay statin except smokers, diabetes, strong family history; 'a score of zero does not imply zero risk'; CAC >=100 favors statin), fetched 2026-10-29. USPSTF final recommendation 2018-07-10, Grade I (insufficient evidence) for adding CAC to traditional risk assessment; update in progress, no draft posted (page last updated 2024-09-19), fetched 2026-10-29.
